evidence: A valid settlement preserves the tree, sets protected_root_radius_feet to 12, sends pears to the food pantry on Thursday with a limit of 4 crates per week, includes post-harvest light pruning and reusable-crate commitments, and uses justification_fact_ids ['PF1'] with revealed ['PF1'].
